name: cx-nodeshape-apps
description: Parent of the per-module-system app variants. Holds the SHARED node_modules (pino) that cjs/, esm/, mjs/ and bare/ all resolve upward into, so one baked copy serves every shape.
//: MUST NOT declare "type": "module" - that would leak ESM semantics into cjs/ and bare/, whose own package.json files are what the ESM probe is supposed to read.
